summary: Verified fix for the duplicated Yahoo forming bar (unaligned O=H=L=C candles at the chart's right edge). Backend: 35 new tests plus the 10 existing iter60 tests pass (45/45). They cover /api/pepper and /api/fx klines for USDJPY/XAUUSD/EURUSD on 5m/15m/1h/4h: all timestamps unique, sorted, aligned to the timeframe and spaced at least one step apart; the last candle is the current bucket. Polling 3 times 10 s apart added no new timestamps. 'before' pages are aligned and join cleanly. Dashboards return the watchlist with price and RSI, bot/scan returns 200 and the pepper backtest (USDJPY ema_cross 15m) returns 200. Frontend: on /pepperstone USDJPY 15m we watched 40 s of polls (5 klines responses). Every timestamp was aligned to 900 s, the label stayed at '300 velas' and the right edge shows regular 15-min labels with no flat cluster. On /hotforex we switched 5m/1h/4h/15m and waited 35 s zoomed into the right edge, which was clean. Scrolling left loaded 2 'before' pages (1300 velas); the merged set had 0 unaligned times and minimum spacing 900, with only weekend gaps. Bybit chart renders (Bitget source). No console errors. Bots left stopped.
critical_code_review_comments: fx/market.py: _normalize and _aggregate are near-identical (only volume max vs sum differs); could share one helper with a volume reducer argument.
fx/routes.py _chart_rows: the MetaTrader/'hfm' candle source (when hfm_state == DEPLOYED) bypasses _normalize. That is fine if MT5 bars are always aligned, but it is not covered by these tests.

Observed (not a bug): Yahoo sometimes returns the forming bucket row as None plus a trade-time-stamped row; _rows drops the None row and _normalize snaps the trailing row into the correct bucket. EURUSD 5m occasionally has a genuine aligned single-tick flat bar, which is real Yahoo data, not the old bug.
